BiblicalUsage: Rephah was a son of Ephraim, counted in the tribal line between Beriah and Resheph. His name stands between Beriah and Resheph in the record of Ephraim's sons.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that a name in Ephraim's line is kept because the tribe itself is kept.
